sources.name: vLLM
sources.evidence: Llama-2-7b TP1 K4096 H11008 O4096 FFN dimensions; M1 and M16. Shape source only; Apple uses its own F32 affine group64 format.

sources.name: MLX
sources.evidence: Native affine quantized_matmul, compiled pure region and Metal QMM; preserving mature native fusion and checked stream completion.

shape_policy: Finite complete-chain architecture qualification, not a production trace or a model throughput claim.
numerics: Unsigned affine Q4/group64, q*F32scale+F32bias; F32 activation, gate/up, SiLU, dense down and output; both arms identical native MLX primitives.
storage: Shared immutable resident compressed gate/up and dense down weights; independent native contexts and two run slots per arm; alternate two distinct ready resident inputs.
selection_policy: Locked mature MLX full-region baseline; this final integration A/A/NI cannot establish a HYLE algorithm advantage. Hardware/software-specific replacement requires separate complete benefit evidence.
